part.text:
Fixed `Blueprint::foreignIdFor` to create an unsigned big integer foreign key for any integer-typed model key, regardless of whether it is auto-incrementing. Previously non-incrementing bigint keys incorrectly fell through to `foreignUuid`, producing a char column.

All 33 tests in `tests/Database/DatabaseSchemaBlueprintTest.php` pass, including the non-incrementing int case.
